summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 8 Auto-Pilot Content Engine. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements present and functional. Pause/resume, settings toggle, queue management, and runs display all working correctly.

Backend: POST /api/admin/auto/settings successfully toggles paused flag (true -> false)
Backend: POST /api/admin/auto/settings successfully toggles auto_publish flag (false -> true)
Backend: GET /api/admin/auto/queue returns 200 with 32 items (28 lessons + 4 paths). Status breakdown: 31 pending, 1 needs_review
Backend: POST /api/admin/auto/queue successfully adds new item to queue
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/auto/queue/{id} successfully removes item (200)
Backend: GET /api/admin/auto/runs returns 200 with 1 run from prior manual test (status=drafted, grades 8/9/9/6)
Backend: POST /api/admin/auto/run {kind:'digest'} returns 200 with {ok:true}
Backend: GET /api/admin/auto/queue/{id} returns single queue item with full doc
Backend: POST /api/admin/auto/queue/{id}/publish on pending item correctly returns 400
Frontend: /admin shows 'AUTO-PILOT' pill (data-testid='admin-tab-auto') in nav
Frontend: Click AUTO-PILOT tab navigates to /admin/auto-content
Frontend: /admin/auto-content page loads with data-testid='admin-auto-content-page'
Frontend: Header 'Auto-Pilot' with zap icon visible
Frontend: 4 stat cards present: Pending lessons, Pending paths, Needs review, Quick controls with auto-publish toggle
Frontend: 'Next scheduled runs (UTC)' section shows 3 cards (Daily lesson, Monday course, Daily digest)
Frontend: All 5 buttons present: Run lesson now, Run course now, Send digest now, Refresh, Pause auto-pilot
Frontend: Pause/resume functionality working - banner appears/disappears, button text changes correctly
Frontend: Content queue section shows topic input, kind select, level select, Add button, and queue list
Frontend: Add queue item via UI works - new item appears in queue list
